quest.title: Connor's Brew
quest.description: The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three Mist Flower Corollas.

talks.objective: Give three Mist Flower Corollas to Connor

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A little bird told me that someone wants Mist Flower Corollas...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Ah, you must have seen that commission of mine. So, do you have those three Mist Flower Corollas handy?

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: Please hurry, then. I'm due to use them to brew up some wine.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: My, my... These Mist Flower Corollas are of fine quality indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Please, take these — consider them a token of my appreciation.
